stories.title: PHAC finds no evidence of mystery brain disease in New Brunswick, says patients still need answers
stories.summary: The Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC) says it has found no evidence of a mystery brain disease that was allegedly affecting hundreds of New Brunswick residents.

stories.title: Four arrested, 220 charges laid in Cape Breton organized crime probe
stories.summary: The Cape Breton police probe began in July 2025 when police were called to find a stolen vehicle that was tracked to a property in Florence, N.S.

stories.title: Program that supports seniors living at home expands in rural New Brunswick
stories.summary: A new program in rural New Brunswick is bringing some of the benefits of a nursing home directly to the community.

stories.title: Atlantic Canadian padres honour Wainwright soldiers in Remembrance Day speeches
stories.summary: Two padres in Atlantic Canada led their Remembrance Day speeches on Wednesday with reflections on the recent deadly fire at CFB Wainwright, in Alberta.

stories.title: Wartime mystery solved as divers find wreck of ship torpedoed by German U-boat
stories.summary: The steamboat was heading from Barbados to New Brunswick in December 1944 when it was torpedoed by a German U-boat. Its wreckage was found this year.

stories.title: N.S. group apologizes for inviting convicted killer to speak at panel
stories.summary: The Elizabeth Fry Society of Mainland Nova Scotia is now apologizing after an event included Marissa Shephard, who was convicted in the 2015 killing of a Moncton, N.B. teenager.

stories.title: Many workers in Nova Scotia, New Brunswick earning below living wage
stories.summary: Two separate reports on the living wages in New Brunswick and Nova Scotia reveal big gaps between what people need to earn just to get by and what they're actually taking home.

stories.title: New Brunswick Premier Susan Holt unveils plan to grow exports outside the U.S.
stories.summary: The New Brunswick government wants to expand its export markets outside the United States by almost 16 per cent by 2030.

stories.title: New Brunswick Premier Susan Holt leading business delegation to Asia
stories.summary: New Brunswick Premier Susan Holt is leading a delegation of businesses to Cambodia and South Korea this month.

stories.title: Wildfire at New Brunswick military base contained, army officials say
stories.summary: The fire at Canada's second-largest military base began Oct. 28, and officials said it was caused by artillery shooting.
